\begin{minipage}{\textwidth}\footnotesize
Note: SysJava Resolved + Platform / Intrinsic + Not Found = JNI Total Natives; SWAT4J Resolved + Not Found = SWAT4J Natives Found: SWAT4J maps the native methods its own bytecode analysis (JTracer) finds, by name, with the third-party JNI libraries shipped in its repository (it never reads the Hadoop and RocksDB ones). Java Lib $\cup$ Container Binary + Go Whitelist ($\Delta$, runc entries not already counted) + Unmapped Lib ($\Delta$, syscalls of loaded libraries without a Java binding, not already counted) = Total Syscalls. Native methods are found on an RTA call graph (virtual and interface calls dispatched to the overrides of every class instantiated in reachable code). Natives in libraries the image does not ship are mapped to the released library (Solr: Hadoop 3.2.0 libhadoop, Hadoop 3.3.6 libhadoop for the 14 erasure-coding natives, netty epoll 4.1.50, Lucene NativePosixUtil; OrientDB: jffi 1.3.11, NativePosixUtil; Elasticsearch: NativePosixUtil; Groovy: the jansi library bundled in jline 2.14.6; Tomcat: jsvc built from commons-daemon 1.2.4); each library is analysed once from all its mapped start functions. The remaining Not Found natives have no implementation in any library (e.g. jffi \texttt{Foreign} natives never implemented upstream, JFR \texttt{setCompressedIntegers} absent from the 8u504 libjvm). Container binaries are analysed from \texttt{\_start} and \texttt{main}; runc is covered by the Go whitelist only. Storm: \texttt{sync} in its generated profile comes only from FFM hits the detector inferred from Clojure class names (JDK 8 has no FFM API) and is not counted; Storm runs under the 179-syscall profile. Elasticsearch: SysPart cannot analyse the stripped ML \texttt{controller}; its syscalls are recovered from the functions it imports. SWAT4J Java Lib = its static allowlist (JTracer); SWAT4J Dynamic = \texttt{strace} of the container start-up. All ten containers run under their generated profiles.
\end{minipage}
